## Website Maintenance & Support Services

**We keep your website updated, secure, backed up and running at peak performance. Focus on your business, we'll take care of your website.**

*We Maintain. You Grow.*

---

### What We Maintain
*   WordPress Core
*   Themes & Plugins
*   Website Files
*   Databases
*   Server & Hosting
*   Security & Firewall
*   Forms & Functionality
*   Images & Media
*   SSL Certificate
*   Performance & Speed

### Our Maintenance Services
*   **Regular Updates:** We keep your website, themes and plugins up to date.
*   **Security Monitoring:** We monitor your website 24/7 for threats and vulnerabilities.
*   **Daily Backups:** Automatic daily backups to keep your data safe.
*   **Uptime Monitoring:** We ensure your website is always online and accessible.
*   **Bug Fixes:** We fix bugs and issues quickly to avoid downtime.
*   **Performance Optimization:** We optimize speed for better user experience and SEO.
*   **Malware Scanning:** Regular scans and removal of malware and suspicious files.
*   **Database Optimization:** We clean and optimize your database for better performance.
*   **Broken Link Check:** We check and fix broken links to maintain user experience.
*   **Content Updates:** We update text, images and content as per your request.

### Key Benefits
*   **Always Up-to-Date:** Your website stays updated with latest features and security.
*   **Maximum Security:** Protect your website from hackers, malware and spam.
*   **Better Performance:** Faster website means happier visitors and better rankings.
*   **No Downtime:** We ensure 99.99% uptime for your website.
*   **Peace of Mind:** We handle everything, you focus on growing your business.
*   **Cost Effective:** Prevent major issues and save on costly repairs.
